name: TrackMania Nations Forever
notes: Use the dedicated DirectX 9 Metal path with TrackMania's tuned audio and scene settings. The OpenGL fallback is available if rendering fails, but can be considerably slower. Performance varies by hardware and track.

name: Counter-Strike 2
notes: Use DXMT for CS2's DirectX 11 graphics. The combined DirectX 9–11 profile also includes this backend. Local play is reported around 60 FPS with the tuned preset on M4. Current tests encounter a signature error on VAC-secured servers, including through Steam's own Play button after verification and a fresh client session with blank launch options. This recommendation covers rendering; secure matchmaking remains blocked in the tested setup.
